function.name: check_loan_eligibility
function.description: Checks whether the customer meets SecureBank's loan eligibility criteria based on their monthly income and the loan type requested.

monthly_income.description: Customer's monthly income in INR (numeric, not string)

loan_type.description: Type of loan the customer is applying for

function.name: get_document_requirements
function.description: Returns the list of documents required for a specific SecureBank loan application.

loan_type.description: Type of loan the customer is applying for

function.name: get_account_balance
function.description: Retrieves the current account balance or outstanding loan balance for the authenticated customer session.

function.name: check_payment_status
function.description: Retrieves the status of a specific payment or EMI transaction.

payment_id.description: Optional payment reference ID to look up

function.name: escalate_to_support
function.description: Escalates the customer's issue to a human support agent. Use for fraud reports, complex complaints, unresolved issues, or any situation outside the agent's scope.

reason.description: Clear description of the issue being escalated (minimum 20 characters)

function.name: route_to_loan_agent
function.description: Transfers the conversation to the SecureBank Loan Agent which handles eligibility, EMI calculations, and documents.

monthly_income.description: Customer's monthly income in INR if already known

context.description: Summary of conversation context to pass to the Loan Agent

function.name: route_to_fraud_agent
function.description: Transfers the conversation to the SecureBank Fraud Agent for identity theft, unauthorised transactions, or suspicious activity.

reason.description: Description of the fraud or suspicious activity reported

function.name: route_to_payment_agent
function.description: Transfers the conversation to the SecureBank Payment Agent for failed payments, duplicate charges, or EMI disputes.

issue.description: Brief description of the payment issue

function.name: route_to_support_agent
function.description: Transfers the conversation to a human support agent for complex, long-standing, or unresolved complaints that automated agents cannot resolve.

context.description: Full summary of the issue and previous resolution attempts

function.name: mcp_check_loan_eligibility
function.description: MCP-protocol version of check_loan_eligibility. Sends a structured request to the SecureBank eligibility MCP server and returns a structured JSON response.

loan_type.description: Type of loan the customer is applying for

function.name: mcp_get_loan_balance
function.description: MCP-protocol version of get_account_balance. Retrieves outstanding loan balance from the SecureBank loan management MCP server.

function.name: mcp_get_document_checklist
function.description: MCP-protocol version of get_document_requirements. Retrieves the current document checklist from the SecureBank document MCP server.

loan_type.description: Type of loan the customer is applying for
